text:
maya: quick note  after deploying quant4b-int4 the longform RAG route shows a quality cascade on our holdout: EM down ~6% and hallucination up. need a targeted curation + relabel.

jon: can you drop a tiny repro and sampling query? want to triage infra vs quant kernel.

maya: samplebank pull done: `samplebank query --route rag-long --model quant4b --delta>0.04 --limit 300 > /tmp/q4b_long_fails.json`. repro example pasted in thread.

li: pattern looks tied to >2500 token contexts. shortctx unaffected. suspect kv-cache alignment plus quantized attention kernel differences.

sara: I can stand up a 150-example micro-golden prioritized by EM delta + halluc signal. labelers: bob + nina available tomorrow AM. I'll include instructions to mark halluc span and type (fabrication vs misinfer).

bob_labeler: ok. please include 3 unambiguous positive and 3 negative examples in the task. helps reduce labelling variance.

jon: eng triage plan: 1) reproduce with prefix-cache disabled, 2) capture kv-diffs for 20 ids, 3) run logits-diff to find token-level shifts. Command I'll run: `kv-diff --ids g-5555,g-5566 --base baseline --new quant4b --out /tmp/kv` and `python compare_logits.py --ids ...`.

maya: also add a de-dup check in sampling  some failures are near-duplicative paraphrases which inflate halluc rates. add `--dedupe=true` to the query for the micro-golden.

sara: task created: https://labelflow/tasks/6201  micro-golden 150, instructions + examples. assigning bob + nina.

deploy-bot: canary monitor: quant4b-int4-v3 auto-rollback at 2024-08-20T11:22Z for route rag-long due to 5.3% quality degradation.

li: once relabels land, let's run ablations: caching on/off, attention-kernel A vs B. if confirmed, options are: tweak quant scales, fall back kernel for longctx, or short-term route-level revert.

maya: timeline: eng triage 6h, label results by tomorrow noon, then kv/logit artifacts attached to the incident ticket. i'll update here when we have artifacts.

sara: labelers starting in 30m, will ping when finished. :thumbsup:
